title: US ‘totally’ rejects global AI governance, White House adviser tells India summit
summary: The US "totally" rejects global governance of AI, White House technology adviser Michael Kratsios said Friday, noting that "risk-focused obsessions" inhibit a "competitive ecosystem". Kratsios addressed an AI summit in New Delhi a day after French President Emmanuel Macron told the gathering that Europe is determined to be a "safe space" for AI innovation.
